verdict: Pre-launch milestones overdue; no paid activity yet this period.
narrative: No paid advertising ran in the last 28 days — Meta and Google both at zero spend — so the account is running on organic presence alone. Your Google Business Profile generated 85 direction requests this period, but zero calls from 100 impressions points to a problem with the call button or listing itself, not a lack of visibility. On top of that, GBP activity dropped 70% in the most recent seven days, which we are investigating now. The pre-launch build milestones that were due between July and September remain open, and clearing those is the direct path to getting paid campaigns live. Once those items are resolved, paid traffic on both Meta and Google is ready to launch and the pipeline will have real volume to work with.
